design: Three fresh teachers with random4distinct3atom groups covering8atoms, paired clean/noisy/nonorthogonal conditions. Training-only uncentered second-moment whitening followed by sparse rotation and unwhitening, decoder column normalization with inverse code scaling. Same H703 teachers/data/settings otherwise; and top3support frequency extraction,1%tail-energy threshold, exactgatecost0.01primary/1e-5sensitivity. Train/val singletonpairs,holdtriples/allout. Noise isotropic SD5%trainingcleanRMS; nonorthogonality D=normalize(Q@(I+0.4cyclicshift)). One same initialization per teacher across conditions. No label fitting or selection.
limitations: Known sizes, full-column-rank8D linear mixture assumption, whitening uses zero-centered population assumption, three teacher seeds not large statistical benchmark. One initialization perteacher/condition. Component intervention score measures recovered synthetic factor contributions, not actual LLM causality.
